about_the_game:
During the ancient times, the human race and the sea race had been living in peace, working together to maintain the harmony and tranquility of the ocean and the earth. However, as the end of the dynasty approaches, a great war was about to sweep the world. In order to protect their homeland, the warriors of the human race and the sea race decided to help each other, practicing and preparing for the war, in order to be invincible in the future war.

Players only need to control the character's movement and steering, and the character will automatically fight. As the battle progresses, the character will be upgraded and gain more combat skills.

There are two modes of upgrading: in-game upgrading and out-of-game upgrading.

You can unlock specific characters after passing the level, or unlock powerful characters if you don't use in-game upgrades.

↓↓↓ Character Introductions ↓↓↓
Land Warrior:

Lotus: A warrior made of lotus root, capable of changing into six arms and wielding six weapons, a powerful descending body. Collection Difficulty: ★★★☆☆

Swordsman: A wandering master swordsman who can change into four arms to wield a sword. Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆

Vanguard: a warrior from the ancient times, able to manifest the form of a dharma body with eight arms, each of the eight hands held a different weapon used in combat. Collection Difficulty: ★★★☆☆

Nezha: A seven-year-old boy who possesses magical treasures, but is overly naughty and has clashed with the Sea Clan.
Collection Difficulty: ★☆☆☆☆

Commander: A golden-armored general with great battle achievements, holding a golden whip and sword, like a divine soldier, he is the master of the battlefield. Collection Difficulty: ★★★★★

Spearman: Elite human soldiers, good at charging into battle, able to giganticize themselves. Collection Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆

Asura: The green-faced, red-haired, three-headed, six-armed Asura King. Collection Difficulty: ★★★★☆

Lictor: Elite human guards with superior protective abilities. Collection Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆☆

Sea Warrior:

Turtle: the elder of the ocean, the most intelligent warrior. Excels in defense and possesses a strong power seal. Collection Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆

Sky Yaksha: The most mysterious sea warrior, able to fly and change, possessing extremely powerful fighting strength. Collection Difficulty: ★★★★☆

King Crab: The main warrior in the ocean, possessing a strong armor, rampaging and specializing in wielding twin swords. Collection Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆

Loong: The king of the ocean, known for its many treasures. In battle, it will change into many arms to use numerous weapons at once. Collection Difficulty: ★★★★★

Goblin: A 1,000-year-old carp with a magic flying hammer that comes and goes without a trace. Collection Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆

Dragon: with infinite strength, specializing in melee combat. Collection Difficulty: ★★★☆☆

Ocean Yaksha: Patroller in the ocean, known for moving quickly and often clashing with humans. Collection Difficulty: ★☆☆☆☆

King Octopus: A highly intelligent creature in the deep sea, capable of fighting with eight arms at once. Collection Difficulty: ★★★☆☆


Email address

Come and experience this amazing battle journey!
